❓ Frequently asked questions

How is specificity calculated?

Count ID selectors (#), then classes/attributes/pseudo-classes (.), then elements/pseudo-elements — written as (a,b,c). A higher component always beats lower ones combined.

How do :not() and :where() count?

:not(), :is() and :has() take the specificity of their most specific argument; :where() always contributes 0.

Does (0,0,12) beat (0,1,0)?

No — (0,1,0) beats (0,0,11): a single class outranks any number of elements. Compare component by component.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
